note: Options embed.js reads that the PHP renderer does not draw. A gallery that sets one with a value goes back to embed.js (Declarative_Renderer::servable). A new option in embed.js fails Declarative_Capability_Test until it is served or listed here. data-ratio is served except for the value original, which Declarative_Look::needs_client sends back. data-sort is served except for random, and for title (alias name) on a host without the intl extension, which Declarative_Selection::needs_client sends back.
